sources.title: How to Apply
sources.publisher: Directorate of Immigration Services, State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services
sources.officialityEvidence: The page identifies the Ministry of Interior and National Administration and its Directorate of Immigration Services as operator.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All visitors including infants and children ... must have an approved Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) before the start of their journey.

sources.title: Kenya Citizenship and Immigration (Amendment) Rules, 2025 (Legal Notice 93)
sources.officialityEvidence: The Kenya Gazette Supplement identifies Legal Notice 93 and states it was printed and published by the Government Printer, Nairobi.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The category of persons set out in the Seventeenth Schedule are exempted from the requirement of obtaining eTA.

sources.title: Exempt from eTA
sources.publisher: Directorate of Immigration Services, State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services
sources.officialityEvidence: The page identifies the Ministry of Interior and National Administration and its Directorate of Immigration Services as operator.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of Kenya and East African Partner States are exempt from completing the eTA.

policies.title: Kenyan citizens are exempt from eTA
policies.summary: Kenyan citizens are outside the eTA requirement.
conditions: This policy concerns Kenyan citizenship and does not determine treatment of a non-Kenyan passport held by a dual citizen.

policies.title: East African Partner State citizens: eTA exemption
policies.summary: Citizens of the named East African Partner States are eTA-exempt for stays not exceeding 180 days.
conditions: The source states an eTA exemption for no more than 180 days.
The normalized visa_free status denotes no eTA requirement; it does not establish separate residence, work, or special-document rights.

policies.title: Listed nationals: 90-day eTA exemption
policies.summary: The listed nationals are eTA-exempt for stays not exceeding 90 days.
conditions: The source states an eTA exemption for no more than 90 days.
The normalized visa_free status denotes no eTA requirement; it does not establish a separate visa, residence, work, transit, or special-document entitlement.
Saint Kitts and Nevis is deliberately not included because the official sources say 'St. Kitts and Navis'; see unresolved item.

policies.title: Cyprus: 90-day eTA exemption
policies.summary: The current official eTA guidance lists Cyprus as eTA-exempt for stays not exceeding 90 days.
conditions: The current portal states an eTA exemption for no more than 90 days.
The Gazette PDF spells the country 'Cyrus'; this legal-text discrepancy is recorded as a conflict.

policies.title: Listed African nationals: 60-day eTA exemption
policies.summary: The current official eTA guidance lists these African nationals as eTA-exempt for stays not exceeding 60 days.
conditions: The current portal states an eTA exemption for no more than 60 days.
Seychelles is included on the portal's 60-day list, but the Gazette also includes it in a 90-day list; the duration conflict is recorded.

policies.title: Other scoped ordinary-passport visitors: eTA required
policies.summary: For the listed ordinary-passport codes not placed in a named nationality exemption, an approved eTA is required before the journey.
conditions: Applies only to the listed ordinary-passport scope after excluding the named national, citizenship, and non-national exemption categories.
An eTA is not final authority to enter Kenya.

This policy does not apply to listed permit, pass, re-entry-authority, transit, crew, private-refuelling, laissez-passer, diplomatic, official, service, special-passport, or British-military exemptions.

application.label: Kenya Electronic Travel Authorisation application guidance
application.processingTime: Typically three working days; it may take longer in some cases.
steps: Use the official eTA portal before travel.
Provide a valid passport, contact details, itinerary, accommodation confirmation, and payment method.
Obtain approval before the start of the journey.

conflicts.explanation: The official 90-day eTA-exemption list includes Guyana; the snapshot says eta.
Indonesia is not in either official nationality-exemption list; the official guidance requires eTA for all other visitors.
The current official portal lists Cyprus for 90 days, while the Gazette PDF spells the entry 'Cyrus'; confirm the legal correction or erratum.
The Gazette PDF lists Seychelles in both 90- and 60-day groups; the current portal places it in the 60-day group only.

unresolved.reason: Not established: both official sources say 'St. Kitts and Navis', which does not exactly identify the ordinary-passport issuer Saint Kitts and Nevis.
